Market today: Geopolitical tensions are flaring, but the real driver for your tech/chip-heavy book is the steady climb of U.S. Treasury yields towards 5%, which usually pressures growth stocks.

Your holdings: SOXL (-52.13%) and SPAL (-30.89%) are flagged for attention as SELL/TRIM. These leveraged ETFs are bleeding on margin, and their decay amplifies losses.

Watch: Keep an eye on Treasury yields and any further escalation in the Middle East.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and protecting your capital.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged position given the significant loss and decay risk.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate reducing exposure due to leverage and decay.
NVDA: Scanner shows an ACCUMULATE setup (entry 218.07-217.85, stop 217.43). Monitor for potential entry if market conditions improve.
